label: Drums wide, vocals close
why: Spreading the drums out leaves room for the melody right in front of you.

label: Strip it to bass and lead
why: Taking out drums and pads shows how the bass and the melody fit together.

label: Dub echo on the lead
why: A tempo-synced echo on the lead makes the gaps between phrases sing.

label: Dark, distant pads
why: Darkening the pads and pushing them aside makes the track feel bigger.

label: Half-time bass drop
why: Dropping the bass to half speed gives a heavy, slowed-down groove.

label: Loop the first two bars
why: Repeating the opening phrase turns it into a hypnotic hook.
